author: llm_offline
behavior: Non-live transport returns before SDK lookup, key lookup, or network.
Live boundary uses official fixed endpoint, gpt-6-luna, Responses, store=False, SDK retries=0 and no tools.
Strict server schema plus bounded local bytes/depth, duplicate-key, exact candidate shape and identity validation.
Only CandidateProposal, never VerifiedSummary/CheckedSummary; existing trusted checker remains independent.
Redacted typed errors; uncertain charge or missing/invalid usage stops further requests.
Public blocked statuses expose bounded safe codes without exception or response text.

validation.mypy_exit_reason: Imported legacy debt; no ignore/skip added.
validation.wheel_metadata: openai==3.50.0 requires extra=openai; base dependencies remain pyyaml

cost_scope: Calls, prompt bytes, output token limit, total reported tokens and analysis work are bounded/recorded. Input token charges are known after service usage, not prepaid; uncertain charge latches stop.

disabled_configuration.shorthand_llm_false: Not part of current API01 contract; raw llm boolean remains a precise configuration rejection.

followup.sdk_discovery_import: All SDK discovery/import exceptions become redacted sdk_unavailable with charge_uncertain=false before client construction.
followup.disabled_sentinels: Tests count SDK imports, API key lookups, transport calls; swallowed exceptions cannot masquerade as zero activity.
followup.budget_scope: N4-BUDGET-01 not claimed; total token ledger remains local/post-usage with uncertain-charge latch.
